gloss: within Tokyo; inside the Tokyo metropolitan area

definitions.gloss: within Tokyo; inside the Tokyo metropolitan area
definitions.explanation: Refers to areas within the boundaries of Tokyo-to (東京都). Commonly used in news, real estate, and everyday conversation to specify that something is located in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {都内|とない}に{住|す}んでいる。
{都内|とない}のホテルを{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I booked a hotel in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {都内|とない}の{家賃|やちん}は{年々|ねんねん}{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: Rents in Tokyo have been rising year after year.

notes: Specifically refers to the Tokyo metropolitan area ({東京都|とうきょうと}), not just the 23 special wards. Common collocations: {都内|とない}に{住|す}む (to live in Tokyo), {都内|とない}の{学校|がっこう} (a school in Tokyo), {都内|とない}で{働|はたら}く (to work in Tokyo). Compare with {市内|しない} (within a city) and {県内|けんない} (within a prefecture), which follow the same pattern of area name + {内|ない}.
